title: Says you won a prize or lottery
why: You cannot win a contest you did not enter. These messages ask for a fee or your details to release the prize.
examples: Congratulations! You have won Rs 25,00,000 in the KBC lucky draw. Call now to claim your prize.
You are the lucky winner of an iPhone 15. Claim your gift today.
safe: Congratulations on your new job! Let's celebrate this weekend.
